feat(voice): add speech-to-speech as a realtime frontend (#50)

* feat(voice): add a speech-to-speech realtime provider

Registers huggingface/speech-to-speech as a second realtime front end on top
of the provider abstraction, without coupling the provider-agnostic frontend
to it.

Three layers keep the integration decoupled:

- providers/ga-protocol.mjs is a pure wire adapter for the GA dialect of the
  Realtime protocol (output_modalities, response.output_text.*, and the
  synthesized session.updated acknowledgement the server never sends).
- providers/s2s.mjs carries the endpoint, session and injection templates.
- Behavioural gaps of the implementation are declared as capabilities rather
  than provider-name branches, so the frontend compensates for any provider
  with the same gap. Every default describes fully specification-compliant
  behaviour, which keeps the DashScope path byte-for-byte unchanged.

Capabilities and their compensations:

- confirmsConversationItems: injected items are sent without awaiting an
  echo that never arrives.
- emitsTerminalEventOnInterrupt: an interruption retires the dangling
  response bookkeeping so the idle gate cannot block queued injections
  forever, plus a fallback expiry for server-initiated responses.
- emitsResponseCreatedForServerTurns: any response.* event proves a
  VAD-driven turn started, so the gateway watchdog stops tearing down
  healthy connections.
- singleResponseSlot: a refused response.create is replayed verbatim with
  escalating delays instead of being dropped, scheduled outside the output
  queue to avoid a deadlock on its own outcome.

The client can select a front end per session through the connect event.

* feat(voice): let clients pick a realtime front end from the WebUI

* fix(voice): let the protocol adapter mint conversation item ids

The GA dialect derives a conversation item's id namespace from its type and
rejects an id from the wrong namespace outright, e.g. "ID must start with
'fco_', got 'item_...'" for a function call output. Injecting a tool result
therefore failed and the frontend never reached the announcement.

Id minting moves from the frontend to the protocol adapter, which is where
the other dialect differences already live: the beta adapter keeps the single
opaque namespace it always used, and the GA adapter maps message,
function_call and function_call_output onto their respective prefixes.

* fix(voice): evict a dead voice owner so it cannot block new claims

An unclean disconnect (e.g. a client network drop that never fires ws close)
left the previous voice client registered as the owner. Because the voice
arbitration only checked whether an owner was recorded, not whether its socket
was still alive, a fresh WebUI connection with the default takeover=false would
wait forever on "等待 WebUI 释放语音": the dead owner never releases.

The owner now exposes isAlive() (ws.readyState === OPEN) and activate() treats
a dead previous owner as absent, granting the slot to the new client. isAlive()
is optional, so callers and tests that omit it keep the original behaviour where
a live owner always blocks a non-takeover claim.

* fix(voice): validate the persisted front end and report forced idle releases

Addresses review feedback on the speech-to-speech provider.

A front end persisted in localStorage was replayed on every connect even when
the server no longer offered it, so a removed provider (or a different
deployment) left the client permanently requesting an unavailable front end.
The selection is now validated against the front ends reported by the health
endpoint and degrades to the server default, clearing the stored value.
retainedRealtimeProvider() keeps that rule a pure, testable function.

forceReleaseIdleGate() also reported nothing, which meant the compensation
silently hid the provider lifecycle mismatches it works around. It now warns
with the provider key, the timeout and the leaked response ids.

* fix(voice): harden speech-to-speech realtime integration

* fix(tui): negotiate and normalize realtime audio rates

feat: let the backend Agent look at the screen or an image (#97)

* feat: let the backend Agent look at the screen or an image

A request about something visible had nowhere to go. The Realtime frontstage
declares only text and audio modalities, so it cannot receive an image, and its
tool set is deliberately fixed at seven. The capability therefore belongs behind
ordinary delegation: the Agent decides whether it needs to look and calls a tool
the Gateway injects alongside the Session tools.

Acquisition uses only what ships with macOS, so no dependency is added. The
screenshot is taken silently, because in a voice product the shutter sound would
be picked up by the microphone, and the result is scaled down: an unscaled
high-DPI screenshot spends a large part of the model's context on pixels it
cannot use. An existing image file is copied before scaling, since scaling
rewrites in place and quietly shrinking a file the user owns should not be a
side effect of asking about it.

Delivery has two forms, because ACP has no notion of a model and no way to
change one inside a Session:

- By default the image travels as an ACP prompt image content block, gated on
  the promptCapabilities.image the Agent declared during initialize. The Agent
  sees the original and can act on it, but its own model must have vision
- With QWEN_AUDIO_AGENT_VISION_MODEL set, the Gateway asks that model and hands
  the Agent a description instead. This is the only way to run an Agent on a
  text model and still answer questions about something visible, and it also
  widens backend support: adapters that speak /v1/responses cannot reach the
  multimodal models that are served only on chat/completions, so under the first
  form they have no vision at all

The image tool is deliberately left out of ACP_SESSION_TOOL_NAMES, the list
handlePermission treats as Gateway-owned and auto-approves, so the Gateway never
silently grants a look at the screen. Whether the user is actually prompted still
depends on the backend's own sandbox policy. A test pins the exclusion.

Off by default, and registered only when the platform can deliver it, so a
backend never sees a capability the user has not turned on. Realtime keeps its
seven tools and the task state machine is untouched.

Verified end to end through the Gateway on macOS with both delivery forms and
with two different backends, each correctly naming applications, project names
and log text that were on screen at the time.

* perf(voice): receipt-based acceptance for backend-bound tools

spawn_thinking and respond_agent_permission are receipt tools: their
result only acknowledges intake, so the spoken confirmation must not
wait on ASR timing or a backend round trip. Result tools (memory, notes,
get_current_time, schedule_reminder) stay synchronous — they are
microsecond-local and the conversation needs their real outcome.

- spawn_thinking: availability now comes from a cached snapshot
  (BackendAvailability, 15s TTL, background refresh, never rejects)
  instead of a per-call health probe; known-down and not-configured
  still fail fast, unknown accepts optimistically and a dispatch
  failure surfaces through the existing failed-task announcement path
- spawn_thinking: the verbatim-request transcript is resolved at
  dispatch inside the owner FIFO lane (whose queueing already covers
  ASR latency) instead of blocking the acceptance receipt; an empty
  model objective keeps the slow transcript fallback
- respond_agent_permission: the local session policy still applies
  immediately, but the ACP delivery is fire-and-forget; on failure the
  policy rolls back and the gateway clears the announced mark so the
  still-pending authorization re-announces through the standard retry
  path (onPermissionDeliveryFailed)

(permission) to the response-queue minimum.

* fix(voice): pin the verbatim request at acceptance to survive transcript eviction

Dispatch can trail acceptance by minutes behind the owner FIFO lane;
twenty-plus newer turns would evict the queued turn's transcript from
the ring buffer, and the dispatch-time lookup would miss it. Registering
the transcript waiter at acceptance (without awaiting it) captures the
ASR result the moment it arrives, immune to eviction, while the receipt
stays instant. Regression test blocks the lane, evicts the turn and
asserts the coordinator still receives the verbatim request.

* feat(memory): 前端记忆系统 —— 偏好自更新、会话回溯、领域资料接入

三条能力，都只在 realtime-api 前端实现，不依赖后端 Agent 的内部机制。
四个开关默认全部 off。

一、偏好自更新（§7）

观察器 → 槽位池 → 晋升器。观察器每场会话结束跑一次，产物进槽位池攒确认，
confirm ≥ 2 且跨 ≥ 2 会话才写进 USER.md 的「观察推断」段。该段与「用户明确
要求」物理分开，冲突时明说恒优先。槽位池落盘，证据能穿越进程重启。

真实模型（qwen-flash）验证暴露并修掉一个结构性死锁：候选被当成「当前已知
画像」喂回模型，模型看到已有就不再报同一个值，confirm 永远停在 1 而门槛要 2
—— 晋升机制整体失效且不报错。1273 个单元测试查不出它，因为 stub 的 llmCall
不会「看到画像后决定不报」。改法是让 tentative 候选对模型隐形；真技能三场后
够门槛的比例 0/N → 3/4。

输出形态为逐字段问答而非自由提取。差别在机制：自由提取时「不报」是消极出口，
模型总要凑几条；问答里 unknown 是必须主动选的答案。A/B 各两轮实测：自由提取
技能栏垃圾 4~7 条，逐字段问答 0~1 条，unknown 占 42~44%。

三道结构性防护挡住「证据真实但推理不成立」：
  value_not_anchored          值的 2-gram 要能在 quote 里找到
  value_parrots_quote         值与 quote 相同 = 复读，不是提取
  quote_not_about_interaction 交互偏好的证据必须指向助手
攒确认挡不住这类错 —— 用户每场都说「题干别太长」，模型每次同样误推成
response_length=brief，confirm 稳稳涨到门槛。计数只挡随机噪声。

二、会话回溯（§5.4 / §5.5）

会话结束生成摘要（话题 + 一句要点，90 天保留），recall 工具按需查。
不注入：清单随会话增长，注入会让 prompt 前缀每场都变、前缀缓存失效。
recall 同时管三个来源 —— 聊过什么、派过什么活、有哪些资料。用户不区分这三者，
模型不该被迫在几个工具之间猜。

摘要里只冻结「派过什么活」的 objective，绝不存 status：摘要是冻结的事实，
任务状态是活的，存下来过几天那个值就是错的且不报错。状态一律在检索时实时读。

三、领域资料接入（§8，部分）

给一条本机路径 → 复制到后端共享 workspace/domain/ → 一次模型调用产出
title / gist / sections → recall 返回 path 供 spawn_thinking 引用。
sections 必须照抄原文标题，它是后端 grep 的锚点，改写就对不上原文。
PDF / Word 派后台任务提取文字，且不回传全文（输出上限装不下、原样复述最不
可靠、resultMetadata 是所有任务共用的台账）；后端说完成后以文件系统为准复核。

已知缺口：硬规则抽取与静态注入未做，所以 policy 合规型场景还不能上线 ——
实测 Gold 档下身份核验执行率为 0%，那条数据直指这一层。

四、抽取器修复

模型有 83% 概率把对话原话当成 old_text，而 apply 是整批原子的，一条坏 edit
会连带丢掉同批里正确的 append。改为调 apply 前按顺序模拟替换，摘掉落不了地的
edit、保住其余。这个功能是唯一默认开启的，缺陷一直在生产路径上。

同时否证了三条「靠 prompt 解决」的路：改 prompt 降 edit 误用（73%→73%）、
basis 含推断词判据（模型在同一句里混写自述与推断）、quote 自述句式判据
（quote 是片段没有主语）。共同教训是模型不可靠处要用结构性防护兜住。

4 轮累积验证、17 case 词表对比，另有跨进程重启与 8 个 HTTP 场景的 curl 验证。

## 边界怎么划的

按 knowledge 协议文档的分层（「入库、列出、完整读取、更新和删除不属于协议
V1」）拆成两半：

knowledge。capability 判据同步收窄成只看 sessionDigests —— realtime-gateway 与
tool-call-handler 两处必须一致，否则会出现「模型看得到工具但调用被策略拒掉」。

## Provider 放在 frontend/knowledge 而不是 domain

层依赖检查（dependency-boundaries）直接报了出来：domain 只允许依赖
core / domain / shared，让「用户给的手册」去依赖前台知识协议是反向耦合。
所以它是协议侧的一个适配器 —— 认识 DomainLibrary 的公开读接口，
而 DomainLibrary 不知道它存在。

## 返回什么

刻意不返回正文。content 是「标题 + 一句说明 + 章节标题 + 正文在哪」，路径放
source.locator（本机路径是私有地址，协议会丢弃 uri 且不生成引用）。

协议要求 content 非空，所以做不到「只给路径」；但给一段有界摘要同样满足轻量，
而且比裸路径更能帮模型判断该不该用这份资料。前端每份资料的占用仍与文档大小
无关 —— 一份 3 页备忘与一份 300 页手册在这里一样大。

装配处是 knowledgeProvider || knowledgeRetrievalProvider || 本机资料库兜底，
一个 Gateway 只挂一个 Provider。这是 Provider 模式的正常语义：用户配了企业知识
服务说明他已有更完整的方案，那时不该用这个轻量实现去覆盖它。真要两者并存，
宿主自己写一层把两个 Provider 包起来（按 knowledgeBaseIds 路由或合并结果），
那是应用层的自由，不需要核心支持。

装配顺序因此调整：knowledge 的装配从文件开头挪到资料库之后。已核实这两处之间

因为那一节正好说明了这里的分层依据：

- 检索归 LocalDomainKnowledgeProvider，管理动作归 DomainLibrary
- 返回摘要而非正文、路径走 source.locator、章节标题照抄原文
- 与外部 RAG Provider 不能并存的原因，并给出宿主自己包一层的示例代码
- 两个已知限制：没配记忆凭据时只能按文件名/标题检索；答不了「我有哪些资料」

## 核对过的事实

文档里的每个常量与变量名都对着代码查了一遍，抓到一处错：原本写的
QWEN_AUDIO_AGENT_MEMORY_API_KEY 不存在，真名是 QWEN_AUDIO_MEMORY_API_KEY
（无 AGENT_），三个文件里都改了。

其余核对结果：CONFIRM_TARGET = 2、SESSION_TARGET = 2、STALE_MS = 90 天、
MAX_LIST_ITEMS = 6、gist 上限 50 字、摘要保留 90 天、终态任务 3 天、
response_length 枚举为 brief|normal|detailed —— 与文档一致。

验证：npm test 全绿，lint 干净。

* fix(domain): 补回「把路径交给后端」的移交指令

D-5 把资料检索从 recall 搬到 knowledge 时漏掉了一环。

原先 recall 的 description 里明确写着「需要资料里的具体内容或要基于它做事，用
spawn_thinking，并在 objective 里带上返回的 path 和相关章节标题」。搬走之后这句
留在 recall 那边被一起删了，而 knowledge 的 description 是主线的通用文案，
里面没有、也不应该有这句 —— 面向外部知识服务时 content 本身就是答案，
不需要再移交。

结果是这条链路断在最后一步：模型能查到「有这份资料、章节有哪些、正文在哪」，
但没人告诉它该把路径交给谁。provider 返回的最后一句是「正文在 X，需要原文时读
这个文件」，没说「谁」去读 —— 而模型手上没有读文件的工具，于是它要么凭标题猜
内容，要么让用户自己去看文件，两种都不对。

引导的正确位置是 provider 返回的 content 里，而不是工具 description：只有本机
资料这个 provider 返回的是路径而非答案，这是它自己的特性。

顺带压掉一处重复：章节列表原本在「章节：」和移交指令里各写一遍，10 章的资料
重复部分就占 220 字符。合并成一处，10 章从 412 降到 311 字符（协议上限 4000）。

补一条测试锁住移交指令：必须点名 spawn_thinking、说清写进 objective、路径出现在
正文里（不只在 locator）、并挡住凭标题猜内容。

验证：npm test 1559 通过 / 0 失败，lint 干净。真实模型跑通完整链路 ——
导入 policy → 摘要产出三个章节一字不差照抄原文 → knowledge 检索命中 →
content 里带出移交指令与路径，且不含任何正文原句。

Four issues made the bench penalize correct model behavior or lose data on a
single connection hiccup.

Climate start vs open: the service treats them differently (start also sets
preconditioning, open only sets ac), but the schema said "start/open=开启空调
或预处理", declaring them synonymous. Rewrite the per-value description so the
preconditioning semantics are explicit, and mirror it in the agent prompt and
the gateway description.

Music tool overlap: music_play, music_pause and music_toggle_playback all
accepted an explicit play or pause. Narrow the music_toggle_playback action
enum to toggle only and route explicit intent to music_play or music_pause.
The agent prompt previously offered "music_toggle_playback 或 music_pause"
while gold only accepted music_pause, so a compliant model was scored wrong.
The service still accepts play and pause for backward compatibility.

Steering wheel heater: steering_wheel_heat_level was a separate target for
what is the level of steering_wheel_heater, unlike seat_heater which uses
(target, action=set, level). Merge it into steering_wheel_heater and honor
level on action=set, which previously collapsed any non-zero level to 1. The
retired target is still accepted by the service and normalized by the scorer.

Realtime turn timeouts aborted the whole case, so one silent connection turned
the remaining turns into missing calls. Add turn-level retry and case-level
restart. A turn is only retried when it produced no tool call and no assistant
text, because re-streaming audio after the model already acted would duplicate
the call. Cases that fail every attempt at the same turn are reported as
confirmed_failure_at_turn, and differing turns as unstable_infrastructure.
Also record function calls dropped outside a turn boundary, which were
silently discarded and inflated the missing-call count.

The scorer now normalizes an omitted vehicle_window_control window to windows,
matching the service default of acting on every window, while still rejecting
a call that names one specific window.

## 批准机制改用两段式，不再用 user_confirmed 参数

原方案是让写库工具带一个 user_confirmed，靠 prompt 要求模型「问过客户再填
true」。那守不住：模型可以不问就填，我们只能事后在审计里发现，而钱已经出去了。

改成第一次调用只返回预览与一枚令牌、不碰数据库，拿着令牌再调一次才执行。
模型没有「跳过批准」这个选项 —— 它拿不到令牌就执行不了。这把流程约束变成了
数据依赖。

三处细节：
- 令牌绑定「动作 + 对象」，不是通用通行证。否则能拿取消 A 单的批准去取消 B 单；
  部分退货还要把款式写进 subject，「退耳机」的批准不能拿去退鼠标。
- 令牌一次性，取出即删。否则一次批准可被重放成多次退款。
- 预览里的金额由 executor 算，不经模型的手。

## 资格判定：查不到就说查不到

退货时限表抄自 policy 第二条，而家具类在细则里确实没写 —— 表里也就没有它。
查不到时返回「细则未覆盖，需转人工」，不挑一个看起来合理的天数。这是「不许
编造」的机制保证：不靠 prompt 请模型别编，而是工具本身给不出数字。

退款超上限时【不发令牌】，直接要求转人工。若只在预览里写「金额较大建议转人工」，
模型照样能往下走。

## auth_required 这条链是通的，实测过了

它在 realtime 侧代码一直是接通的，但座舱示例用不到（开天窗不需要客户批准），
所以此前没有证据说明它真能跑。现在有了：

  工具返回 needsApproval
    → executor 发 TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED + 预览消息
    → adapter 转成 InputRequest{kind:'authorization', status:'pending'}
    → respondInput({action:'accept'}) → 任务恢复 → 带令牌执行 → 订单 cancelled

拒绝路径也测了：respondInput({action:'decline'}) 之后订单保持 pending。

## 过程中撞到三个真实问题

一、首个事件必须是 Task。直接发 statusUpdate 会被客户端拒：
   Received statusUpdate before initial 'Message'/'Task' event.

二、但恢复执行时不能重发 Task，否则报
   Stream ordering violation: received task in task lifecycle stream.
   所以改成只在 requestContext.task 不存在时发。

三、【设计缺陷，不是测试问题】恢复执行时丢了 approval_token。
   runServiceAgent 每次都是空对话开局，模型看不到上一轮的工具返回，
   于是又取了一次预览、又挂起一次 —— 客户会被问第二遍。
   修法：挂起时把预览原文一起存下来，恢复时拼进 objective 交回模型。
   预览里含令牌，这是唯一能把它送回去的载体。

## 一条测试写法上的教训

等 InputRequest 最初写成 setTimeout 轮询事件数组，结果整个测试挂死 45 秒：
submit 没被 await（挂起期间它不返回），轮询又持续占着事件循环，
后台任务推不下去。改成在 subscribe 回调里直接兑现 Promise。

另外事件字段是 event.input 而不是 event.payload.input —— 靠探针打印真实结构
才发现，集成测试超时只能说明「没等到」，说明不了卡在哪一环。

service 56 条 + agent 5 条通过，主干测试未受影响。
反证：去掉 executor 里的 needsApproval 抛出，对应测试立刻变红。

同一份 retail policy 连抽三次（temperature: 0）：

  语义类（order_rules）    三次都不同，其中两次对同一句原文抽出【相反的顺序】：
                           「复述新地址 → 修改地址」与「修改地址 → 复述新地址」

所以 order_rules 一律进待决定栏，不看模型给的 confidence。
一条方向错了的时序规则进了 flows.json，FlowPanel 会把正确流程标成「跳步」——
那比不显示进度更糟。数值类可以直接生成配置。

这不是 prompt 写得不够好，是「哪个动作在前」依赖对业务的理解，
而那份理解不在 policy 文本里。

## 三个抽取质量问题，都是实跑发现的

一、模型把文档章节顺序当业务流程顺序，8 条 order 规则里 7 条是错的

   判据用「两端」而不是「任一端」：第一版按任一端拦，把正确的
   「身份核验 → 办理任何业务」也降级了 —— 「身份核验」既是章节名也是合法动作。

二、模型把我 prompt 里的示例句当成了原文素材，抽出一条 policy.md 里

   示例改成占位符形式，并明说「不要拿本说明里的文字当 quote」。

三、四条抽对了的类别时限被推给人手填：partition 对 window 用了 confidence 判据，

   改成「有可执行的数值 + quote 可核」即算确定，不看模型的自我评价。
   days 缺失时再从 quote 里解析（「30 天」是确定信息，不该麻烦人）。

## schema 借 DMN 的决策表形态

arXiv 2505.11701（DMN-Guided Prompting）指出的问题正是我们的问题：
"Since decision logic is typically embedded in prompts, it becomes challenging
 for end users to modify or refine it."

管理员改不了 prompt 里的逻辑，也改不了 executor 里的 if。表格他能改。

借了三个概念：
- Hit policy（first / unique / collect）—— 规则重叠时怎么办。unique 下重叠
  直接报错而不是随便挑一条，「退货窗口既是 30 天又是 7 天」这种冲突必须暴露。
- 兜底行（wildcard）—— 「未覆盖」从代码里的 undefined 分支变成表里显式一行。
  家具类在 policy 里没写时限，表里也没有它，兜底行把它导向转人工。
- 区间记法 [a..b] / ]a..b[ —— 「7 天内」和「超过 7 天」差一天就是两种结果，
  开闭必须能精确表达。

只实现 FEEL 的最小子集（比较、区间、字面量、通配）。多出来的表达能力换不到
东西，却会让「管理员能看懂这张表」这个前提失效。

## 为什么这个判据比 confidence 强

实测过：同一份 policy 连抽三次（temperature: 0），模型给每条都标 certain，
但 order_rules 每次都不同，其中两次对同一句原文给出【相反的顺序】。
模型的自评不可信，而多次运行的一致性是可观测的事实。

分三档：
  3/3 且每次都是确定项  → agreed，折叠不打扰
  3/3 但每次都判为模糊   → stable_but_ambiguous（稳定地需要人看，比如 gaps）
  同主题不同结论         → conflicting_values，并排显示各版本供人选
  只有部分运行抽出       → partial_agreement，可能漏抽也可能幻觉
分歧最大的排最前面。

* fix(server): delete a knowledge document without fs.rmSync on Windows

On Windows with Node 24, `fs.rmSync` silently does nothing when the path holds
non-ASCII characters: the binding resolves it through the current ANSI code page
instead of UTF-8, so a Chinese filename is looked up under a mangled name, the
resulting ENOENT is swallowed by `force: true`, and the document file stays
behind after `KnowledgeLibrary.remove()`. A sibling file that happens to carry
those bytes re-read in that code page could be removed instead. `unlinkSync`
goes through libuv's UTF-8 to UTF-16 conversion and targets the right file; the
surrounding try/catch keeps the previous semantics (a file that is already gone
or cannot be removed never blocks dropping the index entry).

Reproduced on a Chinese-locale Windows host with Node v24.11.0:

    fs.writeFileSync('手册.md', 'x')
    fs.rmSync('手册.md', { force: true })
    fs.existsSync('手册.md')   // true  -> still there
    fs.unlinkSync('手册.md')
    fs.existsSync('手册.md')   // false -> gone

That is why `removing a document deletes the copied file too` fails on such a
host on Node 24 while passing on Node 22, and why a Chinese-named directory
survives `rmSync(..., { recursive: true })` as well.

This does not explain the intermittent `windows-latest / Node 24.15.0` CI
failures seen around the same time: in those runs the server suite passes (this
case included, 17-21ms) and an unrelated example suite is reported as
`test failed` with no diagnostics. That is a separate, environmental problem.

* ci: retry the Windows test suite once on silent test-process exits

windows-latest intermittently kills an entire test file's child process: the
runner reports `✖ <file> ... 'test failed'` with a non-zero exit, no failing
assertion and no diagnostics. It lands on a different heavyweight example suite
each run (smart-cockpit gateway composition, AI Passport device relay), fails the
same way on main, and never reproduced in ~120 targeted reruns on
windows-latest / Node 24.15.0 (3 shards x [15 smart-cockpit groups + 15 AI
Passport groups + 10 composition runs] plus three full `npm test` runs).

Retry `npm test` once on Windows only and announce the retry as a warning
annotation, so a flaky pass stays visible in the job instead of hiding a real
regression. Two failed attempts still fail the job; other platforms keep the
single-run behaviour.

* fix: remove files and trees without fs.rmSync on Windows

On Windows Node 24 fs.rmSync goes through a C++ binding that interprets the path
with the ANSI code page instead of UTF-8, so a non-ASCII target is silently
mangled: the delete either does nothing (force swallows the ENOENT produced by
the mangled name) or lands on a sibling file named after those bytes re-read in
that code page. unlinkSync/rmdirSync go through libuv's UTF-8 to UTF-16
conversion and address the intended path, so add removeFileSync/removeTreeSync
next to the other Windows compatibility helpers and use them where the target
can carry a non-ASCII name:

- desktop skin directories (user-named skins, uninstall and staging cleanup)
- wake-word model staging files under the user data directory
- voicemem audio staging files

The knowledge library already switched to the same primitive in c256017; the new
regression test pins the behaviour for both helpers.
